items.followUp: State and explain two advantages of using a computer network.

rubric.why: Recognizes that networks let users share hardware resources.
rubric.description: A network allows connected users to share hardware, such as printers.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for explaining that hardware resources can be shared.

rubric.why: Recognizes that networks let users share software or information.
rubric.description: A network allows users to share software, data, or files.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for mentioning shared software, data, or files.

rubric.why: Identifies communication or information exchange as a reason for networking.
rubric.description: A network makes communication and the exchange of information easier.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for mentioning communication or exchange of information.

rubric.why: Explains that sharing resources can lower costs.
rubric.description: Sharing resources over a network can reduce the cost of equipment and software.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for explaining that networking can reduce costs.

modelAnswer: A computer network connects computers so users can share hardware resources, such as printers.
Users can also share software, data, and files over the network.
A network makes communication and the exchange of information between users easier.
Sharing resources can reduce the cost of equipment and software.
